shots.purpose: Open in media res: a fireball streaks over the taiga morning while the forest below still stands
shots.claim: the 1908 Tunguska event flattened roughly 2,000 square kilometres of forest and left no crater at the centre
shots.evidence: era-field plate: bright fireball streak over dark taiga silhouette, morning horizon, the forest unbroken
shots.motion_reason: slow push toward the streak so the fireball-versus-standing-forest mismatch reads at once

depth.note: fireball plane over taiga ridge layers reconstructs the morning scene

subject_contract.expected_subject: sepia archival plate: fireball streak over a dark taiga silhouette at morning

one_second.relationship: something enormous crosses the sky above an unbroken forest

shots.purpose: Anchor the human record: heat on skin, chairs thrown, at the Vanavara trading post 65 km out
shots.claim: eyewitnesses about sixty-five kilometres from the epicentre reported feeling heat and being thrown from their seats
shots.evidence: era-field plate: trading-post cabins with thrown figures and heat rays crossing the yard, date anchor 1908
shots.motion_reason: drift along the scene so the thrown-figure relationships carry the shot

depth.note: heat-ray plane in front of the cabin plane

subject_contract.expected_subject: sepia plate: trading-post cabins, knocked-down figures, heat rays, 1908 anchor

one_second.relationship: sixty-five kilometres out, the blast still throws people

shots.purpose: Show the event's global footprint: barograph trace, radiating pressure rings, a sky that will not darken
shots.claim: the event registered on barographs and seismographs far from Siberia and was followed by documented reports of bright night skies across Europe and Asia
shots.evidence: era-field plate: a barograph drum with the pressure-wave trace, concentric rings spreading, glow band at the horizon
shots.motion_reason: slow sweep across rings so the propagation reads outward

depth.note: instrument card in front of the ring field

subject_contract.expected_subject: sepia plate: barograph drum with pressure trace, concentric rings, glow horizon

one_second.relationship: the wave reached the instruments; the sky stayed bright

surprise.evidence: the radial blowdown opens around upright stripped trees on bare, uncratered ground

depth.note: survey view: radial fan, standing poles, bare ground

shots.purpose: Reveal the contradiction: 1927 — radial blowdown, upright pole trees at the centre, and no crater
shots.claim: the first scientific expedition in 1927 found a radial blowdown with upright stripped trees at ground zero and no crater
shots.evidence: era-field survey plate: trees laid flat in a radial fan around a centre of upright stripped poles, bare uncratered ground
shots.motion_reason: pull out from the standing poles to the full radial fan so the contradiction lands in one move

subject_contract.expected_subject: sepia survey plate: radial blowdown fan, upright stripped poles at centre, bare ground, no crater

one_second.relationship: the trees fell outward yet the centre's poles still stand

shots.purpose: Show the leading model hedged: a stony body bursting 5-10 km up, the shock wave doing the damage
shots.claim: the leading model holds that a stony asteroid tens of metres across burst at an altitude of roughly five to ten kilometres, flattening the forest by blast wave
shots.evidence: era-field cross-section: entry streak, burst flash at altitude, downward shock cones onto the forest fan
shots.motion_reason: follow the entry path down to the burst so the altitude relationship is the motion

depth.note: atmosphere cross-section layers: entry lane, burst plane, forest plane

subject_contract.expected_subject: sepia atmospheric cross-section: entry streak, burst flash at altitude, shock cones onto a forest fan

one_second.relationship: the body bursts in the air and the shock wave strikes the forest

shots.purpose: Jump the band to 2013: Chelyabinsk's recorded airburst confirms the mechanism on camera
shots.claim: published energy estimates for Tunguska span about 3 to 30 megatons, it ranks as the largest impact event in recorded history, and the 2013 Chelyabinsk airburst verified the airburst mechanism
shots.evidence: era-field plate: bright trail over a city skyline, windows bursting from the shock, timeline band jumped to 2013
shots.motion_reason: drift along the trail so the same-physics recognition builds

depth.note: trail plane over the city plane, band anchor in front

subject_contract.expected_subject: sepia plate: bright airburst trail over a city skyline with shocked windows, 2013 anchor

one_second.relationship: the same physics, recorded on camera a century later

shots.purpose: Resolve the hook: no crater was ever missing — the airburst signature is written in the forest
shots.claim: the absence of a crater with standing ground-zero trees is the expected signature of a high-altitude airburst, which is how the Tunguska event is read today
shots.evidence: era-field payoff: the radial fan and standing poles under a calm sky, the complete signature in one frame
shots.motion_reason: slow pull-out, the frame settles as the argument does

depth.note: fan, poles and sky settle into one calm composition

subject_contract.expected_subject: sepia payoff: radial fan with upright poles at centre under a calm sky

one_second.relationship: the crater was never there; the forest holds the signature
